text:
maya (partnerships): Quick sync: CipherGate (HSM + secrets mgr) wants to pilot a marketplace listing with two SI integrators. Scope: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, KMS keywrap + secrets manager passthrough. Need to validate flow + assets for co-announcement.

ryan (security): Key items: CipherGate expects customer-managed keys with wrap/unwrap via EKU-restricted certs. They also require HSM attestation docs (TPM/SCAR) and a short threat model for secrets passthrough. I'll draft the threat model.

nina (eng-platform): For SCIM we need to confirm group->team mapping and whether CipherGate supports bulk PATCH. Also, does their secrets manager support dynamic creds rotation via webhook? If yes we'll wire the webhook to our secret-sync service.

vlad (ciphergate-ops): We support SCIM v2 with bulk operations and can send rotation webhooks to an HTTPS endpoint with mTLS. Portal: https://partners.ciphergate.example/metadata (SAML + SCIM schema). We'll provision a dev tenant on request.

tom (infra): mTLS + webhook is fine. We'll create a partner ingress in the sandbox VPC and provide client certs. ETA 48h. Also confirm IP ranges for the SI partners so we can open the proper egress rules.

maya (partnerships): Timeline suggestion: Day 0 metadata exchange, Day 2 dev tenant + VPC peering, Day 5 integration smoke tests, Day 10 SI dry run, Day 14 marketing assets locked. Thoughts?

ryan (security): Sounds good. One blocker: legal needs to vet joint messaging around "FIPS-level" or "hardware-backed" claims. I'll loop legal and product-comms. Also will add a requirement: audit logs for unwrap must include requester id + hashed key fingerprint.

nina (eng-platform): We can emit audit events to our central log stream with hashed fingerprints. For performance tests, we want to simulate 5k unwrappings/minute and see impact on latency. Can CipherGate give expected per-operation P50/P99?

vlad (ciphergate-ops): Dev HSM metrics: P50 unwrap ~12ms, P99 ~120ms for 2048 RSA-OAEP. AES-GCM unwrap is ~8ms p50. We'll provide a small load generator you can run against the dev endpoint.

marketing-bot: Reminder: co-announcement assets (one-pager, joint blog, logo usage) needed 7 days before publish. See checklist: https://internal.redwood/docs/marketplace-coannounce-checklist

tom (infra): Action items from infra: 1) create sandbox ingress + mTLS certs (48h) 2) whitelist SI IPs (need list) 3) enable SCIM proxy endpoints (/scim/v2/*) with 500 reqs/min burst token bucket.

maya (partnerships): Action items summary: @vlad provide dev tenant creds + SAML/SCIM metadata (EOD), @tom ready ingress + certs (48h), @ryan draft threat model + legal loop (this week), @nina perf spec + audit hooks (end of week). I'll schedule a weekly check-in Thurs 11am PT.

vlad (ciphergate-ops): Dev tenant creds posted to partner portal. SAML metadata: https://partners.ciphergate.example/saml-meta.xml. Note: we only support SP-initiated flows and require metadata signed by the IdP.

ryan (security): Noted. I'll add a short checklist to the repo for SAML config (algorithms, nameid format, assertion lifetime). Also will request attestation PDFs from CipherGate for our security review.

nina (eng-platform): I'll stand up the perf harness once I have the dev creds. Can someone add the SI leads to the invite? maya?

maya (partnerships): Will invite SI leads after we confirm VPC peering. Thanks everyone, will post the combined checklist + calendar invite. :rocket:
